# Fabric items built by hand (not generated by the converter)

`PL_Spark_Test` ran two Synapse Spark notebooks. Its Spark work now runs on **Azure Databricks as external compute**,
in ADF and in Fabric alike. The notebooks live in the Databricks workspace (source: [../databricks/](../databricks/)), and
both pipelines call them with Azure Databricks notebook activities. Setup, cluster and costs:
[docs/compute-and-databricks.md](../docs/compute-and-databricks.md).

Fabric workspace: **adf-migration-test** (`53d67e72-8124-4ca3-ae55-c4b266935faa`).

| Fabric item | Type | File here | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PL_Spark_Test` | Data pipeline | [pipelines/PL_Spark_Test.pipeline-content.json](pipelines/PL_Spark_Test.pipeline-content.json) | Two Azure Databricks notebook activities, in the Synapse order: `Generate_CSV_And_Parquet` runs `/Shared/adf-migration/NB_Read_Raw_Data`, then `Transform_Parquet` runs `/Shared/adf-migration/NB_Transform_Cab_Data`. |
| `Databricks_dbw_adf_migration` | Connection | – | Azure Databricks workspace `https://adb-7405618998257241.1.azuredatabricks.net`, token authentication. The token is held only in the Fabric connection. |
| `LH_Migration` | Lakehouse | – | Has the OneLake shortcut `Files/migrationcontainer` → ADLS `datamigrationadftofabric` / `migrationcontainer` (through the `Sathvik-ADF` connection). |
| `NB_Read_Raw_Data`, `NB_Transform_Cab_Data` | Notebook | [notebooks/](notebooks/) | The Fabric Spark versions of the same notebooks, kept in the workspace. `PL_Spark_Test` no longer calls them. |

**Cluster settings on each activity** (Fabric Azure Databricks activity, `typeProperties`):
- `newClusterVersion` `15.4.x-scala2.12`, `newClusterNodeType` `Standard_D4ds_v5`, `newClusterNumOfWorker` `0`;
- `policyId` `0018796FECE9BEFE` (cluster policy `adf-migration-single-node`), `dataSecurityMode` `SINGLE_USER`;
- `newClusterSparkConf` for single node, `newClusterCustomTags`.

The connection id goes in `externalReferences.connection`.

All output goes under `migrationcontainer/migration-test/spark-test/`, so the Copy pipelines' files in
`migration-test/csv` and `migration-test/parquet` are never overwritten.

**Do not redeploy `PL_Spark_Test` from the converter.** Restore it from the file here (Fabric REST API
`updateDefinition`). The converter's own Databricks mapping leaves the cluster settings to be filled in.
